[[File:Solari_Lightsaber_Crystal.png|thumb|right|200px|The Solari crystal]]
The '''Solari crystal''' was one of the oldest and most powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. It was a light orange gem that only a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who was pure in spirit and an ardent follower of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] could use. It could not be corrupted by the dark side and its owner had to always stay pure of heart for it to function.<ref name="sal">{{Tales|23|Shadows and Light}}</ref>

==History==
Once the possession of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ood Bnar]], he offered it to his very promising apprentice, [[Shaela Nuur]], for he felt she would always stay true to the light side. However, during the [[Cleansing of Korriban]] at the end of the [[Great Hunt (Jedi)|Great Hunt]], after her Jedi companion [[Duron Qel-Droma]] fell to a [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]] in the [[Tomb of Naga Sadow]], Nuur started feeling the pull of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]], as she wished for nothing else but vengeance upon the beast that killed her friend and lover. As a result, the crystal reacted by disabling her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] while she was ambushed by her quarry and a second Terentatek,<ref name="sal" /> leading to her death<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> and leaving the fate of the Solari crystal unknown.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|397|Nurr, Shaela}}</ref> Years later, the skeletal remains of a [[human]] individual were found close to two Terentateks by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]. After defeating the [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawns]], the redeemed Jedi was able to recover a datapad that once belonged to Nuur, along with a Solari crystal.<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Other variations==
Additional Solari crystals, while rare, were not as difficult to come by as some of the rarest of crystals, such as the [[Kaiburr crystal]] or the companion crystals known as the [[Heart of the Guardian]] and the [[Mantle of the Force]]. Utilizing the crystal in one's lightsaber would increase the width of its blade, increasing a Jedi's ability to deflect blaster bolts.<ref name="jatm">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

While [[Shaela Nuur]]'s crystal had an orange hue to it,<ref name="sal" /> other solari crystals could imbue a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber's]] energy plasma blade with a variety of colors.<ref name="jatm" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although the Solari crystal was an artifact of light side power, in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', the [[Heart of the Guardian]] and [[Mantle of the Force]] lightsaber crystals could remove the light side restriction and allow a dark side character to use the crystal.<ref name="kotor" />
